title: fix(app-shell): the report and dashboard-widget pickers show a dataset member's label and the dataset's description (objectui#11161)
body:
Fixes #11161
Clause-②: no

## What an author now sees

The report inspector and the dashboard-widget inspector show the text a dataset declares, beside the machine names. This is the objectui sub-issue of objectstack-ai/objectstack#20282, as the triage ruled it (comment 5903169797).

- **Measure and dimension options show the member's `label`.** The add-member lists in both inspectors read `Revenue · sum` with `revenue` in the code chip beside it, and `Stage` beside `stage`. The report's chart-axis selects read `Stage (stage)` and `Revenue (revenue) · sum`. The dashboard's filter-binding field picker shows `stage`, then `Stage`.
- **Dataset options show the dataset's `description`.** The report's dataset select reads `Sales pipeline (sales_pipeline) — Open deals by stage`. The dashboard's searchable dataset picker shows the description as the option's muted hint.
- **Nothing declared, nothing changes.** A member with no label reads `deal_count · count` or `region`, and a dataset with no description reads `Bare metrics (bare_metrics)`, exactly as before.
- **A map-valued label resolves in the designer's language.** `{ en, zh-CN }` labels and descriptions read their `en` entry under English and their `zh-CN` entry under Chinese. A language switch re-reads them without refetching the catalog.
- **What a pick stores is unchanged.** Every option's value is the machine name. The label never reaches `report.values`, `rows`, `columns`, the chart axes, `dataset`, or the widget's `dimensions`, `values` and `dataset`.
- **No `/analytics/meta` reader, no authored cubes**, per the triage.

## Where it landed

All in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, the claimed surface. `_shared.tsx` is untouched: its select renders each option's `label` as given, so the report's dataset options carry the description in their label text.

- `previews/useDatasetCatalog.ts`
  - `toCatalogEntry(doc, locale)` keeps each member's `label`, the dataset's `description` and the dataset `label`. It resolves all four through the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` in `locale`. A blank or non-text value reads as undeclared. There is no `String()` of a label.
  - The hand-rolled `resolveLabel` is gone. It read a string or a `{ default }` object only. The spec resolver reads the untagged `default` entry itself, so that spelling still resolves (pinned).
  - `useDatasetCatalog` and `useDatasetSemantics` keep the documents as served. They resolve where they return, in `useMetadataLocale()`.
  - The entry's new fields are `description?` on the dataset and `label?` on each member. All of them are optional strings, so the `datasetCatalogOverride` contract is unchanged.
- `inspectors/ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`
  - `datasetMeasureOptions`, `datasetDimensionOptions` and `datasetPickerOptions` live next to `DatasetNamesEditor`, which the widget inspector already imports from here. They are the one form both inspectors build their options from.
  - The chart-axis options use the same `LABEL (name)` text the dataset picker has always used.
- `inspectors/DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`: its dataset, dimension, measure and filter-field options come from those builders.

## The mechanism readings the order asked for

1. **What the old reader did with a map label.** Measured, not read: the base `useDatasetCatalog.ts` was put under the new pin. For `label: { en: 'Sales pipeline', zh-CN: '销售管道' }` it answered `sales_pipeline`, the machine name. So a map-valued dataset label never reached the picker. That case is folded into the spec resolver, and no second resolver remains.
2. **Where the locale enters: as a required `toCatalogEntry` parameter.** The hooks supply `useMetadataLocale()`. Four reasons:
   - A catalog entry leaves the one seam as display-ready strings. No consumer can render a raw locale map, which reads `[object Object]` in a template literal and throws as a React child.
   - The `datasetCatalogOverride` type stays string-typed.
   - The pure function stays unit-pinnable in both languages.
   - A language switch re-reads the text without a refetch. That is the pattern `useDatasetSemantics` already follows for its not-found sentence (objectui#10862).
   Both hosts pass `useMetadataLocale()` as the inspectors' `locale` prop (`ResourceEditPage`, `ReportConfigPanel`), so the options and the rest of the inspector read in one language.
3. **Does `useDatasetSemantics` read the same entry?**
   - When the list carried the members, it reads the same catalog entry.
   - When the list carried a summary, it hydrates once with `get('dataset', name)`.
   - Both paths now go through `toCatalogEntry` in the designer locale. The new pins cover both: the report's list answers full documents, and the dashboard's list answers summaries, so its members come through `get`.
4. **Existing pins.** `git grep` for `useDatasetCatalog`, `toCatalogEntry` and `DatasetMeasureInfo` over test sources finds:
   - three report test files that type their override fixtures as `DatasetCatalogEntry`;
   - `DashboardWidgetInspector.test.tsx`, which mocks the module's two hooks.
   No expected option text moved, because none of those fixtures declares a member label or a description: `deal_count · count` and `Sales metrics (sales_metrics)` read as before. `ReportDefaultInspector.joinedClearsBinding-10746.test.tsx`, which PR objectui#11086 edits, is untouched.

## Verification (all at `d5dc4a99d`, the head of this branch)

- **New pins** (`useDatasetCatalog.authorText-11161.test.ts`, `datasetPickers.authorText-11161.test.tsx`): `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 24 passed (24)`.
- **The order's test gate**: `pnpm exec vitest run` over `inspectors/` and `previews/`, plus `ReportConfigPanel.panelTitle.test.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.servedDraftTakenAsIs-10765.test.tsx`, the two other suites that mount these inspectors. Result: `Test Files 201 passed (201)`, `Tests 2733 passed | 1 skipped (2734)`.
- **Type-check**: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exits 0. The script echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`. It ran after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...' --concurrency=2`, which reported `28 successful, 28 total`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists both new test files among its 4782 program files.
- **ESLint** on the five changed source and test files: 0 errors. The warnings delta against the base, per file:
  - `ReportDefaultInspector.tsx`: +3 `react-refresh/only-export-components`, one per exported builder. They are warn level, and exported helpers beside components are the tree's existing pattern (`FlowReferenceField.tsx`, `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx`).
  - `useDatasetCatalog.ts` and `DashboardWidgetInspector.tsx`: unchanged.
- **Other gates, each exit 0**:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: 1 released package, 1 changeset.
  - `check:control-bytes`.
  - `check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`.
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`.
  - `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
  - `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, and `check:esm-specifiers` (its specifiers-only leg).

**Ablations.** Both ran from the committed head. Each restore was proven by `blob == HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **The base catalog file restored in place.** The on-disk blob equalled the base blob. Result: `Tests 20 failed | 4 passed (24)`. The four green cases are the ones the base already satisfied: the names and type keys, the dataset-label fallback, the `{ default }` spelling, and a nameless document.
- **The measure option's stored `name` set to its label** (through `ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor hit x1 to x0). Result: `Tests 6 failed | 18 passed (24)`. Both "a pick stores the machine name" pins went red, with `values` receiving `Revenue` instead of `revenue`, and so did the four measure-option pins whose name chip read the label.

**Not measured here, left to CI:** the full `pnpm test` and lint farm, and a browser pass. No live console was driven.

## Acceptance notes

These are observations and are not filed.

- **Picked rows still show the stored name.** `DatasetNamesEditor`'s rows (the values and rows already bound) show the machine name, not the label. The triage scoped this card to the options, so the rows are left as they were.
- **The report's dataset select shows the description in its trigger too.** A Radix select mirrors the chosen item's text into its trigger, so the trigger reads `LABEL (name) — description`, clamped to one line by the trigger's own style. Avoiding that needs a secondary-text slot in `InspectorSelectField` (`_shared.tsx`), which this card did not need.
- **Long descriptions wrap on the right in the dashboard picker.** `InspectorComboField`'s `hint` suffix has no truncation, so a long description wraps there.
- **A measure's `format` is still dropped by `toCatalogEntry`.** The card named it, and the triage's direction did not ask for it.
- **`plugin-dashboard`'s `WidgetConfigPanel` is untouched.** It keeps its own catalog type, which already has an optional member `label`, and no in-repo host passes it a catalog.
